explanation: Counting back 119 days from 5 January 2026 lands on 8 September 2025, and with the as-of day that makes 120 days. Going back 120 days starts on 7 September, one day too early. date_diff('month', ...) counts month starts crossed, not days, so it keeps all of September, and INTERVAL 4 MONTH starts on 5 September.
